entries.title: How to Massively Increase Your Productivity and Happiness in 2 Hours Per Day
entries.author: staunch
entries.current_title: How to Massively Increase Your Productivity and Happiness in 2 Hours Per Day
entries.excerpt: Go to sleep 2 hours earlier than you normally do! It's easy to fall into the sleep deprivation trap and think you're getting more out of yourself, even when you're really not. I've always found the need to sleep at all very frustrating, so this lesson is hard-learned for me. I'm still in love with my 36 hour hackathons, but now most days I'm trying to get enough sleep to feel energetic all day without in assistance from drugs like caffeine and nicotine.
entries.guide_zh: 作者建议提前两小时睡觉，以改善效率与幸福感。

entries.title: Am I the only one who doesn't care about Facebook?
entries.author: henning
entries.current_title: Am I the only one who doesn't care about Facebook?
entries.excerpt: All the social networks look like boring walled gardens/roach motels to me. Great if you can get in on the ground floor for the next big one, lousy for all the users. I'm not willing to buy into an application platform that isn't open and vendor-neutral. For networking, I think there are better ways, like plain old face to face talking: the "hallway track" in conferences is often better than any of the talks. I don't get it. And Zuckerberg stole the idea anyway.
entries.guide_zh: 作者不理解 Facebook 的吸引力，并质疑封闭社交平台。

entries.title: What is going on with the editing of submission titles?
entries.author: dpapathanasiou
entries.current_title: What is going on with the editing of submission titles?
entries.excerpt: Twice now, I've seen my submission titles edited by someone else (probably Graham or his admins, if he has any for this site). Both times, the edits were innocuous (the first one improved the title ever so slightly) but unnecessary. It's not a huge problem, but it is a bit annoying.
entries.guide_zh: 用户发现投稿标题被别人修改，希望了解网站编辑规则。

entries.title: Why is it hard to startup a company outside of Silicon Valley?
entries.author: ahsonwardak
entries.current_title: Why is it hard to startup a company outside of Silicon Valley?
entries.excerpt: This may sound like a dumb question to some, but I need to be edified. I'm in DC, and it seems more and more that you're probably working in something government or defense related. In other cities, like Dallas, it used to be telecom related (The Telecom Corrdior). How do these clusters start, thrive, and/or die? How does it continue to thrive in Silicon Valley after some 20 to 30 years of startup success stories?
entries.guide_zh: 为什么创业资源聚集在硅谷，其他城市的产业集群又如何形成？
